generalCriterionList.description: Tenders  from Joint ventures are not acceptable.

Bidders shall not be under a declaration of ineligibility for
 corrupt and fraudulent practices issued by Government of Karnataka
Bidders shall ensure upload of relevant document certifying his/her status as Scheduled Caste/ Scheduled Tribe/other reserved category as prescribed in the tender document.

It shall be the responsibility of the Bidder to ensure credit of Tender Processing Fee and EMD into the respective receiving bank accounts of e-Procurement on or before the last date and time of bid submission.
EMD Payments through e-Payment mode shall be made as one single transaction and payments made in part are liable for rejection.
Conditioned tenders will not be accepted.
The GST, Royalty, Income Tax & Other concerned Taxes will be deducted in works bills as per rules

To qualify for Award of this Contract, the Financial Turnover for each Tenderer in his /her name should have in the last Five Years i.e. 2021-22, 2022-23, 2023-24, 2024-25 & 2025-26 achieved at least in any TWO Financial years an average Financial Turnover not less than two times of the tender amount for General Category and for Reserved Category achieved at least in any One Financial years an average Financial Turnover not less than the tender amount.
The Employer reserves the all rights to accept/ Reject any or/all Tenders and to cancel the tender process at any stage prior to award of the contract without assigning any reason.

Availability by owning at least 50% of the required / specified key and critical equipment for this work and The remaining 50% can be deployed on lease / hire basis for all works provided, the relevant documents (commitment agreements etc.,) for availability for this work are furnished

Liquid assets and or availability of credit facilities of not less than (Credit lines/ Letters of Credit/ Certificates from Banks) for meeting the fund requirement etc., (usually 30% of the amount put to tender) (Bank address and date of issue is mandatory).
The department is not responsible for any delay in accessing KPPP Portal.
All terms and Conditions as per tender documents.
ONE % of bill amount of the successful tenderer will be deducted as Building and other construction worker welfare cess.
The tenderer should maintain the work during the defective liability period of one year.
All materials required for the work, shall be procured by the tenderer himself and should be got tested by the quality control from the approved authorities at his own cost before use on work.
Agencies that have not completed previous work within the Stipulated time, since THREE Years in any one of the Divisions of K.S.D.B. will liable to be rejected

To qualify for Award of this Contract, each Tenderer in his /her name should have in the last Five Years i.e.,2021-22, 2022-23, 2023-24, 2024-25 & 2025-26 satisfactorily completed as a Prime Contractor at least 1 similar nature of work value not less than 50% of the amount put to tender for General Category and 25% for Reserved Category. (Scanned copy of the Work done Certificate issued by the Competent Authority of Rank not less than the Executive Engineer should be uploaded

Statement indicating the total value of the Civil Engineering works executed and received in last Five years Certified by the Chartered Accountant to be Scanned & uploaded.(UDIN number must be Mentioned)
Tenders from contractors who have not completed the works in time in any department, and/or Having litigation history or financial failures etc. will not be considered.
The Execute Engineer, No.3 Division, KSDB Bangalore has rights to accept or reject any or all tenders without giving any reasons.

The details and other information will be made available in Executive Engineer, KSDB, No.3, Division KSDB, Bangalore office which can be collected during office hours. And also can see in the tender document.

If the contractor/Agency intended to quote less than the Tender Amount contractor shall put a DD. for the Tender difference amount quoted drawn in favor of Executive Engineer, No. 3 Division, K.S.D.B. Bangalore. The Tender Difference Amount of D.D. should be produced at the Office of the Executive Engineer, No. 3 Division, and KSDB Bangalore as specified before final date & time of closing event of calendar.
GST Amount will be paid at the time of billing.
DD Scan copy should be upload in KPP Portal.
If the calendar of events is postponed, inform through the KPP-portal only.

The Tenderer should visit the proposed site with concern Assistant Executive Engineer and submit the feasibility report regarding completion of works & upload the Site visit letter. The site visit letter failing to comply with these norms will make the tender liable to rejection.
The tenderer should be an Eligible Registered Valid Civil KPWD License issued by the competent Authority.
if the bidders coats below the tender amount he/she should submit the Original DD to the division office by dated23.11.2026 before 5.30PM

itemList.description:
Dismantling of existing structures like culverts, bridges, retaining walls and other structure comprising of masonry, cement concrete, wood work, steel work, including TandP and scaffolding wherever necessary, sorting the dismantled material, disposal of unserviceable 
material and stacking the serviceable material with all lifts and lead

Earth work excavation by manual means for drains, canals, waste weir, draft, approach channels, key trenches, foundation of Buildings andbridges and such simillar works in all kinds of soils, as per drawing and technical specifications, including setting out, shoring, strutting, barricading, caution lights, removal of stumps and other deleterious matter, excavated surface leveled and sides neatly dressed disposing off the excavated stuff or sorting andstacking the selected stuff for reuse in a radius of 50 m and lift upto 1.5 m including cost of labour, tools andother appurtenaces required to complete the work.
Removal of Unserviceable Soil with Disposal upto a suitable distance as directed by the Engineer incharge of work

Providing and laying in position plain cement concrete for levelling course for all works in foundation. The granite/trap/basalt crushed graded coarse aggregates and fine aggregates as per relevant IS Codes machine mixed, laid in layers not exceeding 150 mm thickness, well compacted using plate vibrators, including all lead andlifts, cost of all materials of quality, labour, Usage charges of machineries, curing, and all the other appurtenances required to complete the work as per technical specifications. (The cost of steel reinforcement andformwork shall be paid separately) Mix 1:4:8 Using 40 mm nominal size graded crushed coarse aggregates

Providing and laying in position Reinforced cement concrete for all Sub structures of building, Irrigation works, Sub structure works of bridges, Drain works andother parallel works from 0.50m to 3.50 m height. The granite/trap/basalt crushed graded coarse aggregates and fine aggregates as per relevant IS Codes machine mixed with super plasticisers, laid in layers, well compacted using needle vibrators, providing weep holes wherever necesary, including all lead andlifts, cost of all materials of quality, confirming to the requirements of relevant IS codes, labour, Usage charges of machinery, curing and all other appurtenances required to complete the work as per technical specifications. (The cost of steel reinforcement andformwork to be paid separately) M20 Design Mix Using 20 mm nominal size graded crushed coarse aggregates

Providing and laying in position Reinforced cement concrete for all Sub structures of building, Irrigation works, Sub structure works of bridges, Drain works andother parallel works from 0.50m to 3.50 m height. The granite/trap/basalt crushed graded coarse aggregates and fine aggregates as per relevant IS Codes machine mixed with super plasticisers, laid in layers, well compacted using needle vibrators, providing weep holes wherever necesary, including all lead andlifts, cost of all materials of quality, confirming to the requirements of relevant IS codes, labour, Usage charges of machinery, curing and all other appurtenances required to complete the work as per technical specifications. (The cost of steel reinforcement andformwork to be paid separately) M20 Design Mix Using 20 mm nominal size graded crushed coarse aggregates

Supplying, fitting and placing TMT Fe 550 550D Steel Reinforcement including cost of all materials, machinery, labour, cleaning, straightening, cutting, bending, hooking, laping/welding joints, tying with binding wire soft annealed steel wire and other ancilary operations complete as per drawing and technical specification. h.All other type of structures

Providing PVC ringtite pipes conforming to IS 4985:2000 with latest amendments and conveying to worksite, rolling and lowering into trenches, laying true to line and level and perfect linking at joints, testing and commissioning, including loading unloading at both destinations and cuts of pipes wherever necessary including jointingof PVC pipes and specials (excluding cost of specials) with jointing of approved type, with all labour with all lead andlift including encasing the pipe alround to a depth of not less than 15 cms. with soft gravel or selected earth available from the excavation etc. complete and giving necessary hydraulic test to the required pressure as per ISS (Contractor will make his own arrangements for procuring water for testing)

Providing and installing at site of work P.V.C. pipes including cost of pipes and specials and labour, including lowering into trenches, laying true to line, level and perfect linking at joints leak proof including jointing of approved type with all labour charges and alllift charges, handling chargesincluding encasing the pipe around to a depth not less than 15 cms with gravel or selected earth available from the excavation etc. complete 6 Kg/m2:63mm

Supplying and laying at site Factory made perforated hard HDPE subsoil drainage pipes pre-wrapped with 150 gsm Geotextile for subsoil drainage system includingall necessary coupling/ fittings for joints andback filling with aggregates.The pipe shall be manufactured from High Density Polyethylene (HDPE). It shall be extruded into an open lattice wall structure, with  60% of the circumference consisting of open area and a 30% solid area along the invert. The product should satisfy the following parameters as below 1. Ring Stiffness as per ISO 9969: 2016 should be  0.8 kN/m2. 2. Resistance to Acid with 3% HCl for 24 hrs without mass loss, change in colour, softening, cracking or spalling. 3. Resistance to Alkali with 3% KOH for 24 hrs without without mass loss, change in colour, softening, cracking or spalling. (Excavated material to be utlised in roadway at site)110mm dia HDPE pipe

Filling available excavated earth (excluding rock) in trenches, plinth, sides of foundations and other similar works etc. in layers not exceeding 20cm in depth, consolidating each deposited layer by ramming and watering, lead up to 50 m and lift upto 1.5 m.
